name: Metomidate
summary: Metomidate is a non-barbiturate imidazole that was discovered by Janssen Pharmaceutica in 1965 and under the names (Hypnodil, Nokemyl) is sold as a sedative-hypnotic drug used in Europe to treat humans and for veterinary purposes.

uses.text: Metomidate is a non-barbiturate imidazole that was discovered by Janssen Pharmaceutica in 1965 and under the names (Hypnodil, Nokemyl) is sold as a sedative-hypnotic drug used in Europe to treat humans and for veterinary purposes. 11C-labelled metomidate (11C-metomidate), may be used with positron emission tomography (PET).

summaryZh: 美托咪酯（英語：Metomidate）是一種非巴比妥類咪唑類藥物，由楊森製藥公司於1965年發現並以Hypnodil 、 Nokemyl等商品名出售，作為一種鎮靜催眠藥物，在歐洲用於治療人類和獸醫用途。
summaryZhHans: 美托咪酯（英语：Metomidate）是一种非巴比妥类咪唑类药物，由杨森制药公司于1965年发现并以Hypnodil 、 Nokemyl等商品名出售，作为一种镇静催眠药物，在欧洲用于治疗人类和兽医用途。
